== Research Notes ==

A possible identification concerns Master Benjamin Glasgow, Cookstown school-support donor. Master Benjamin Glasgow of Cookstown is listed for one shilling towards support of scholars in the agricultural school in June 1850.<ref>Belfast News-Letter, 28 June 1850, p. 2, agricultural-school scholars’ support; [https://www.newspapers.com/image/390559842/ record].</ref> A donor list, not proof that Benjamin attended the school. “Master” supplies no exact age. [[Glasgow-2059]] (reported born about 1835) and [[Glasgow-2566]] (about 1840) are compatible young catalogue namesakes; assignment to either, or to the Drapersfield Benjamin, is unresolved. The surgeon who died in 1833 is excluded. The identification remains uncertain.
